definitions.explanation: The body's protective response to injury or infection, characterized by redness, swelling, heat, and pain. A fundamental medical condition.

examples.japanese: {喉|のど}に{炎症|えんしょう}が{起|お}きている。
{炎症|えんしょう}を{抑|おさ}える{薬|くすり}を{処方|しょほう}された。
examples.english: I was prescribed medicine to reduce the inflammation.

examples.japanese: {関節|かんせつ}の{炎症|えんしょう}で{歩|ある}くのが{辛|つら}い。
examples.english: Walking is painful due to joint inflammation.

notes:
MEDICAL TERMS:
- {炎症|えんしょう}を{起|お}こす: to become inflamed
- {炎症|えんしょう}を{抑|おさ}える: to reduce inflammation
- {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}: anti-inflammatory
- {慢性|まんせい}{炎症|えんしょう}: chronic inflammation
- {急性|きゅうせい}{炎症|えんしょう}: acute inflammation

COMMON TYPES:
- {肺炎|はいえん}: pneumonia (lung + {炎|えん})
- {胃炎|いえん}: gastritis (stomach + {炎|えん})
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}: arthritis
- {皮膚炎|ひふえん}: dermatitis

FIVE SIGNS OF INFLAMMATION:
{発赤|ほっせき} (redness), {腫脹|しゅちょう} (swelling), {発熱|はつねつ} (heat), {疼痛|とうつう} (pain), {機能障害|きのうしょうがい} (loss of function)
